plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Hal Peary is credited on 340 distinct recordings across 9 programs from 1934-10-09 through 1979-07-24. Documented roles include performer on 339 recordings and guest on 1 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are The Great Gildersleeve (performer on 311 recordings; 311 distinct recordings), Fibber McGee and Molly (performer on 20 recordings; 20 distinct recordings), Sealtest Variety Theater (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), Sears Radio Theater (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), CBS Radio Workshop (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), Calling All Cars (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), Duffy's Tavern (guest on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), and Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Throckmorton P. Gildersleeve (317 portrayals).
